verdict.rationale: Fly.io describes its pricing as pay-as-you-go, billed only for the compute, storage, and bandwidth actually used [fly-io-docs-21]. Usage-based billing also appears for disk bytes [fly-io-docs-10] and tool calls [fly-io-docs-6], so a devops lead can conclude that cost scales with usage, not headcount. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that there are no per-seat or per-member charges, no documented absence of minimum seat counts or plan minimums, and no independent corroboration of how team size affects cost.
